items.title: Police and protesters clash in some of France's worst unrest in years
items.snippet: The protests in France began last ‌month at high schools in Paris' poor northern suburbs, where anger over teacher shortages and shabby facilities evolved into a broader movement focused on inequality, public spending and living standards.

items.title: Looting, blazes and clashes in France amid nationwide protests
items.snippet: Police and protesters clashed violently in Paris and other French cities on Saturday on the sidelines of nationwide marches against soaring inflation, with one demonstrator’s hand blown off, multiple blazes set, and looters breaking into dozens of stores to strip them bare. items.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new U.S. sanctions on Russia hours after Trump paused them
items.snippet: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged supporters on Saturday to speak out in defence of new U.S. sanctions against Russia, hours after President Donald Trump signed an executive order pausing a sweeping package of restrictions targeting the Russian economy.

items.title: Israeli settlers attack European diplomatic cars in West Bank and beat French mayor, say witnesses
items.snippet: Cars from the French, Belgian and Polish missions had brought diplomats to visit Taybeh, a largely Christian village in the occupied West Bank, when settlers descended to stop Palestinians from gathering olives, witnesses said.

items.title: Trump waives Russia-related sanctions before they even kick in as Ukraine ties worsen
